    Additive closure in a preadditive category #

    source
    def EFiniteCharacterizations.IsInAdd {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] (X Y : C) :
    Prop

    The object X belongs to the additive closure of Y if its identity is a finite sum of compositions through Y. In a category with finite direct sums, this means that X is a direct summand of a finite sum of copies of Y.
